AN OLD PRACTICE, A NEW POSSIBILITY

The art of
paying attention.

For centuries, readers have kept commonplace books: personal collections of passages, observations, and ideas. A place to put a thought so it can become part of how you see.

01

Find your words.

Explore more than 100,000 quotations from Goodreads collections, the QuoteKG archive and our original collection, or add passages from your own reading. QuoteKG retains Wikiquote attribution and citation context; these are not independent verification.

02

Make a life in pages.

Choose by subject or suggested reading age. Topics and age guidance are generated editorial suggestions, not developmental assessments. Browse the Goodreads collection by recorded likes. Counts come from historical dataset snapshots and show their snapshot year; they are not live. You can also supply a count when adding a personal quote.

03

Put it into the world.

Create a reading PDF, a separate print interior, and a full wrap cover. Check your printer’s trim, minimum pages, bleed, and spine specifications before ordering. QuoteKG data is credited to Tin Kuculo, Simon Gottschalk, Elena Demidova and Wikiquote contributors under CC BY-SA 4.0. The Goodreads quote additions come from the CC0-labeled datasets by Abhishek Verma and Souradip Pal; historical popularity facts are matched from the 2020 faellielupe snapshot. We filtered, normalized, deduplicated and categorized the collections. Underlying quotations may have separate rights; review passages before publication.

Your drafts, favorites, and personal quotes stay in this browser. Use Back up to keep a portable copy or move your collection to another device. This site does not sync your collection across devices.

FROM YOUR SCREEN TO YOUR SHELF

Print & ship your book.

Make a private copy with Lulu. We prepare the files; Lulu prints and delivers.

2. Open Lulu & order ↗

The download is a ZIP. Open it, then upload the two PDFs to Lulu.

Exactly what to do on Lulu
  1. Start a Print Book. Choose Print Copies for Your Own Use.
  2. Upload 01-interior.pdf as the interior. Choose 5 × 8 Novella · paperback · Standard Black & White · 60# cream · matte cover.
  3. Upload 02-cover.pdf as your own cover. It already includes the front, spine, and back.
  4. Review Lulu’s preview and cover template. Choose copies, enter your address, and pay. Lulu prints and ships.
Lulu’s official walkthrough ↗

Use the two print PDFs, rather than the reading edition. Price and delivery options are shown at Lulu checkout.
